name: Rick Davidson
source:
The man in charge. Will do whatever it takes to ensure Camden’s future success and prosperity. Many of the residents are enamored with the charming mayor, but he seems to have finally taken a personal interest in the doe-eyed Camila Phillips.

[From [url=https://jaimescribblesgames.com/2018/01/19/as-we-know-it/]Jaime Scribbles Games[/url]]
